source.content: @isTest private class SchemaDescribeTokenEdgesFixtureTest { @isTest static void describesTokensAndCreatesSObjects() { Map<String, Schema.SObjectType> globalDescribe = Schema.getGlobalDescribe(); System.assert(globalDescribe.containsKey('Account')); Schema.SObjectType accountType = globalDescribe.get('Account'); System.assertEquals(Account.SObjectType, accountType); System.assert(accountType.equals(Account.SObjectType)); System.assert(!accountType.equals(Contact.SObjectType)); System.assert(accountType.hashCode() != Contact.SObjectType.hashCode()); System.assert(accountType.toString().contains('Account')); List<Schema.DescribeSObjectResult> byName = Schema.describeSObjects(new List<String>{'Account'}); System.assertEquals('Account', byName.get(0).getName()); List<Schema.DescribeSObjectResult> byNameDeferred = Schema.describeSObjects(new List<String>{'Account'}, Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.DEFERRED); System.assertEquals('Account', byNameDeferred.get(0).getName()); System.assertEquals('Account', accountType.getDescribe(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL).getName()); System.assertEquals('Account', accountType.getDescribe(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.DEFERRED).getName()); System.assert(Account.Name.equals(Account.Name)); System.assert(!Account.Name.equals(Contact.LastName)); System.assert(Account.Name.hashCode() != Contact.LastName.hashCode()); System.assert(Account.Name.toString().contains('Name')); System.assertEquals('Account Name', Account.Name.getDescribe(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.FULL_DESCRIBE).getLabel()); SObject blank = accountType.newSObject(); System.assertEquals(Account.SObjectType, blank.getSObjectType()); Id accountId = '001000000000001AAA'; SObject withId = accountType.newSObject(accountId); System.assertEquals(Account.SObjectType, withId.getSObjectType()); System.assertEquals(accountId, withId.get('Id')); SObject withDefaults = accountType.newSObject(accountId, true); System.assertEquals(Account.SObjectType, withDefaults.getSObjectType()); System.assertEquals(accountId, withDefaults.get('Id')); } }
